title: Resort Club Member Rate on Room Reservations Room-Type Moves
content:
Holders of Resort Club Memberships at a resort are charged a member rate on the room-type differential when their Room Reservations reservation at that same resort is moved to a room type that sleeps its registered adults.

**Member notice.** When the guest holds an active Family Resort Club or Founders Resort Club membership at the same resort, the differential is charged at the family club rate of 70%; an active membership of any other level at that resort is charged at the club rate of 85%; a guest with no active club membership at that resort pays the full club-free rate of 100%.

**What decides the rate.** The guest's Resort Club Memberships record at the resort the reservation is for — the membership's level and its status. Only the status active counts; a membership that is pending, frozen, under notice or terminated is not an active membership, and a membership at another resort is not a membership at that resort.

| Club membership of the guest at the same resort | Share of the differential charged |
|---|---|
| Family Resort Club Membership, active | 70% |
| Founders Resort Club Membership, active | 70% |
| Fitness Club, Pool & Fitness Club, Spa Club or Beach & Pool Club Membership, active | 85% |
| Any level, not active | 100% |
| None at that resort | 100% |

**Member questions answered.**

*I hold a Spa Club Membership at the resort. What do I pay on a room-type move there?* The differential is charged at 85%: a hypothetical differential of 40.00 becomes 34.00.

*My Founders Resort Club Membership is frozen. Does the family rate apply?* No. The family club rate needs an active membership; a frozen one leaves the differential at 100%.

*I am a Family Resort Club member at another Ashbury resort.* The rate reads the membership at the resort of the reservation only; with none active there, the differential is charged at 100%.
